---
applyTo: "knowledge/memes/**/*.md"
---

# Meme / concept entries

A "meme" here means a recurring cultural concept, motif, idiom, or phenomenon that shows up across *multiple* books — not an image macro. Copy `knowledge/memes/_template.md` to start.

```yaml
title: ""
title_en: ""
first_documented: 0
themes: []
# books: — DO NOT add or edit this field by hand. It's generated by sync.js
# from every book's `memes:` field via reverse lookup. If you hand-edit it,
# it will be silently overwritten on the next build.
```

## Body sections
- `## What it is` — concise, original description of the concept.
- `## Where it shows up` — prose pointing to the general pattern; the authoritative list of which books reference this meme lives in each book's own `memes:` frontmatter, not here.

## Before creating a new meme file
Check it doesn't already exist under a different slug — search `knowledge/memes/` first. Two meme files describing the same concept fragments the graph instead of connecting it, which defeats the point of this layer.
